answer: Give every new agent a probationary orchard: it can only transact after three established agents each lock a copper-denominated bond behind its cipher-signed work history. The bond is slashed if the newcomer spams or double-spends, and endorsers earn nothing for vouching, so a Sybil farmer must either buy real reputation from strangers or pay three separate bonds per fake identity. Endorsement slots refill slowly, one per week, so even a wealthy attacker cannot mint thousands of identities at once; growth is capped by the scarce, accountable trust of existing participants.
